divergences.upstreamResult: Controller exposes field.onChange for React synthetic change events.
divergences.octaneResult: Controller exposes field.onInput for Octane native input events; mode and option names retain upstream onChange spelling.
divergences.rationale: Octane observes native per-keystroke input events rather than React synthetic change events.
divergences.consumerImpact: Controller render props use onInput where React consumers expect onChange.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Bind field.onInput to the native input handler; retain onChange naming only in react-hook-form configuration values.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces a React-compatible synthetic event layer or changes its native input contract.

divergences.upstreamResult: React suppresses an input event when its tracked value is unchanged.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane delivers the native input event and react-hook-form notifies its value subscribers.
divergences.rationale: Octane intentionally uses native DOM events without React's synthetic value tracker.
divergences.consumerImpact: A programmatically dispatched no-op input may produce one additional watcher render.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not dispatch input events when the DOM value has not changed if render counts are significant.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds synthetic value tracking.

divergences.upstreamResult: React batches microtask-separated handleSubmit notifications into one committed parent render.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane commits each microtask-spaced notification, producing two parent renders.
divergences.rationale: The runtimes intentionally have different scheduler and automatic-batching boundaries.
divergences.consumerImpact: Render-count assertions and effects tied to each commit observe an extra intermediate commit.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Assert final form state rather than React-specific intermediate render counts.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes microtask batching semantics.

divergences.upstreamResult: React batching exposes two resolver state commits.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane exposes a third content-identical resolver state commit.
divergences.rationale: Separate Octane render passes expose notifications React automatically coalesces.
divergences.consumerImpact: Effects subscribed to resolver state may run once more with equivalent content.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Make state effects idempotent and compare semantic error content when deduplication matters.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts React-compatible automatic batching.

divergences.upstreamResult: React act drains the in-flight validation microtask chain before returning.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane act returns before a fire-and-forget validation notification schedules its final render.
divergences.rationale: Octane act has a narrower async flush boundary than React act.
divergences.consumerImpact: Tests may observe stale subscribed formState immediately after an async act body.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Wait for the asserted UI/state condition instead of relying on React act's macrotask drain behavior.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane act expands its async drain contract.

divergences.upstreamResult: React batches mount validity and reset notifications into two observed renders.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane exposes an additional intermediate render while preserving the same final state.
divergences.rationale: Octane commits notification passes that React batches.
divergences.consumerImpact: Render counters observe one extra render during reset with isValid subscribed.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Depend on the final mounted and validity state, not React-specific render counts.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes notification batching.

divergences.upstreamResult: React re-enters render once before bailing out on an Object.is-equal computed watch value.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane eagerly skips the equal-value parent render.
divergences.rationale: Octane's eager bailout avoids React fiber's probe render.
divergences.consumerImpact: Render counters observe one fewer render when compute returns the current value.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Treat compute as pure and avoid relying on component-body execution when its result is unchanged.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes eager equality bailout semantics.
